title: Yext Address
description: The structured physical address for a Yext location entity.

address.description: The building number and street address of the location.

address2.description: Second line of address (e.g., suite number).

displayAddress.description: Additional information to help consumers find the location. Presented alongside the main address.

state.description: The state, province, or region of the location.

postalCode.description: The postal or ZIP code of the location.

extraDescription.description: Any additional description that is not part of the formatted address.
